# Aurora (`aurora`)

Northern lights rippling above a dark ridge.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: heavy (~7.7 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Aurora
